tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Searches Refapp's help center (support.refapp.com) for articles on how to use Refapp, such as sending reminders to references, project settings or background checks. Returns the best matching articles with title, link, language and a short excerpt. When no article exists in the requested language, articles in other languages are returned.

query.description: A few keywords from the question, in the user's language

language.description: Language of the question: sv, en, no (Norwegian) or da

tools.name: get_help_article
tools.description: Returns one article from Refapp's help center as plain text, with its links. Accepts support.refapp.com knowledge-base links only.

tools.name: explain_status
tools.description: Explain a status shown in Refapp for a candidate, project or background check. Accepts the status as shown in the app in any of Refapp's languages (e.g. "Försenade", "Review needed") or its internal name (e.g. "overdue"). Returns the label in every language and what it means; when nothing matches, lists the known statuses.

tools.name: explain_concept
tools.description: Explains what a basic Refapp concept is, such as a project, candidate, referee, questionnaire, report or project template. Accepts the name in any of Refapp's languages (e.g. "Kandidat", "Prosjektmal") or a short question that names it. Returns the name in each language and what it means; when nothing matches, lists the known concepts.
